The surname of '''Barran''' can refer to the following people, possibly all of the same family:
*[[Doral Barran]] - a former [[Wisdom]] of [[Emond's Field]].
*[[Hilde Barran]] - a [[novice]] with the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]], originally from the [[Two Rivers]].
*[[Hu Barran]] - a stableman employed at the [[Winespring Inn]] in Emond's Field, brother to Tad.
*[[Jondyn Barran]] - an old man from the Two Rivers, and a very good tracker.
*[[Tad Barran]] - a stableman employed at the Winespring inn in Emond's Field, brother to Hu.
